inspected_anchors.finding: Title, authors, venue identity and project URL; identity checked against the published original.
Visual Genome relation annotations, graph templates and subgraph matching generate the stipulated scene graphs.
LLM-generated questions and distractors; original binary questions have nearly equal Yes/No distribution.
Four-step CELLO-CoT; experimental test set is1200 questions,100 randomly selected per task.
Table2 twelve task accuracies, task averages and ALL; GPT-4o reported ALL .59→.70 and confounder identification .29→.35.
Section6.4 reformulated robustness questions always have correct answer No; correct refusals may cite model inability to act rather than the scene mechanism.
Limitations: original annotation quality, unclear images and static-image versus dynamic-reasoning boundaries.
AppendixB.2 two annotators,120 instances,10/task;91.7% valid and reported Cohen kappa84.1%.
Table5 robustness: Qwen-VL .04,BakLlava .03,GPT-4o .57; task differs from the original causal questions.

supported_claims: A scene-template benchmark tests response consistency against constructed labels, not experimentally established intervention effects.
The all-No robustness label distribution permits a constant-No perfect classifier; original binary task balance is a separate property.
The twelve displayed GPT-4o+CELLO-CoT task accuracies average .6875 under equal100/task, whereas ALL is .70; conventional rounding does not reconcile that interpretation.
Historical author-reported performance and question-validity annotations do not establish present bank accuracy or causal truth.
unresolved_source_issues: Equal-task/ALL aggregation discrepancy remains unresolved in the published original; no raw result reconstruction or cause is asserted.
limitations: Author primary-text review only; no upstream engine, model call, banking experiment or measured ROI.
The inherited candidate census and complementary literature search remain incomplete.
Paper availability does not establish code, dataset, dependency or deployment rights.

inspected_anchors.finding: Title, author, DOI, posted date and paper CC-BY4.0 notice.
Table2 states12 scenarios, four domains, three difficulties, four tasks, four strategies and two replicates.
Illustrative minimum-wage, antibiotic and post-deployment latency scenarios; mechanism assumptions need explicit separation from observational identification.
Four causal task types and prompting strategies repeat the underlying scenario grid.
Equations1–3 set-overlap CIR, epsilon1e-8, forward/ambiguous/reverse CLP categories.
Equations4–5 CCR=CIR outside counterfactual tasks; CAR weights .40/.35/.25; author-defined gold annotation.
Three Groq-hosted model identifiers; mostlytemperature0,contrast-case first pass .1.
1152 total responses; seed42 where supported; Mann–Whitney and bootstrap descriptions; whitespace/stemming/regex implementation; public-release assertion.
Automatic-metric limitations and incomplete human validation.
Author gold, small scenario/model coverage, contamination and construct validity limitations.
Data Availability Statement says benchmark data, code, gold and raw results are available on reasonable request.
Appendix minimum-wage gold structure explicitly notes empirical debate; this is a stipulated mechanism, not a universally identified effect.
AppendixB.5 historical zero monetary API charge and about18h rate-limited runtime; not total workflow economics.
AppendixD.1 selects .40/.35/.25 weights among15 combinations on24 responses rated by two experts; selected Kendall tau .78.

supported_claims: The reported1152 outputs repeat12 underlying scenarios; repeated strategies/tasks/models are not1152 independent mechanisms.
Set-overlap CIR ignores token order; paper CLP is a separate directional check and no uninspected regex exploit is claimed.
The selected pilot correlation is selection-set agreement, not held-out metric validation.
The paper contains conflicting public-release/on-request availability statements; no public code/data copy or upstream reproduction is established.
Historical free-tier API charge does not price annotation, review, waiting or current inference.
unresolved_source_issues: Public-release assertions conflict with the on-request Data Availability Statement; executable code/gold/raw results remain uninspected.
The exact response pairing and resampling unit are not established by the inspected methods; do not reconstruct source confidence intervals.
Textbook or author-stipulated gold does not supply general bank causal identification.
limitations: Author primary-text review only; no upstream engine, model call, banking experiment or measured ROI.
